blocks.text: To edit a machine provisioning key:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Private Access Authentication > Machine Provisioning Keys.
In the table, locate the machine provisioning key you want to modify and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: The Edit Machine Provisioning Key drawer appears.
Only keys that can be viewed or exported after creation appear in the table.

blocks.item: In the Edit Machine Provisioning Key drawer, you can modify the following fields:

View or Export Provisioning Key After Creation: Disable this option to hide the provisioning key from the Provisioning Key column of the table and disable copying or downloading the key after creation. If disabled, you cannot enable this option after creation. If this option is enabled, you can disable it later. This option is enabled by default.
Name: Edit the provisioning key name.
Status: Enable or disable the provisioning key.
Allow Re-Enrollement: Enable or disable the ability to re-enroll the provisioning key.
Signing Certificate: Edit the signing certificate for this provisioning key.
